services.name: Ocean Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: Person: $25.00 About Try the fun-filled and thrilling Banana Boat rides! Our experienced captains are all well trained professionals out on the water who hold your safety as their number one priority. Your trip will begin by signing up with our friendly staff in the booth and then you will receive life jackets and safety instructions. When it is your time to ride, you will be directed towards the water where you will await your vessel. When your captain arrives, you will simply load the banana boat and hang on tight! You will travel 2 miles down the Myrtle Beach shore and back on an 2-3 Mile Ride

services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Join us daily at Downwind Sails for the parasailing adventure of a lifetime! Person: $89 About Ride out deep into the ocean on a banana boat shuttle with your family and friends to soar up to 400 feet above the Grand Strand area, all while witnessing spectacular scenery and sea creatures below. Our professional and experienced staff works to ensure that you have a safe and enjoyable trip out on the water with us. In order to make this happen, we ask that you follow a few simple rules and regulations. You must be at least 42 inches tall to take part in any of our activities and there is $79-89 per person • 30-45 Minute Excursion & 10 Minute Parasailing

services.name: Sail Boat Rentals
services.desc: 16' Hobie Getaway 1 Hour: $85 16' Hobie Getaway 2 Hour: $145 About Downwind Sails has been sailing the Atlantic off the coast of Myrtle Beach since first opening our doors in 1974. We are home to a fleet of state of the art Hobie Cats that are sure to provide your family and friends with waves of fun in the sun! Downwind Sails offers rentals and lessons on one of our 14ft Hobie Wave and 16ft Hobie Getaway sailboats for the experienced seaman and beginners alike. If you are an experienced sailor, you may rent the vessel of your choice by the hour, day or week, depending on availability. Starting at $85 • 1 or 2 Hour Rentals

quotes.text: We went ocean kayaking which was an absolute blast! It was cheap and so much fun! You got to go where you wanted without a guide! Then we had to go back the next day for more so we tried parasailing! I definitely recommend trying it. It's not as scary as it looks! Going up is smooth as well as coming down. We even got some pictures taken and they turned out great!

Went parasailing with Downwind Sails about a week ago. I've parasailed before in Hawaii and found that Downwind Sails really delivers a great experience. From start to finish I was impressed with their crew and their equipment. They are very safety conscious and tell you exactly what to do. Could not have been more pleased with experience!

Staff was great. We had very positive experience Hobie sailing. We went out a second day and had same great time. They were extremely patient with us. They are successful in delivering a positive customer experience.

quotes.author: MikeMoAtl
quotes.text: There's a reason why Downwind Sails has been in Myrtle Beach forever. They are awesome folks and I'm glad I got to go out on a Hobie Cat and SUP. I'll do the parasailing, jet ski and more on the next visit.
